headlines: SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT FROM 11 PM EST THIS EVENING THROUGH TUESDAY AFTERNOON

periods.name: Tonight
periods.text: Southwest winds 10 to 15 knots becoming northwest 15 to 20 knots. A chance of rain early, then rain likely late this evening. Waves 1 foot or less building to 2 to 4 feet.

periods.name: Monday
periods.text: Northwest winds 15 to 20 knots diminishing to 10 to 15 knots. Sunny. Waves 2 to 4 feet subsiding to 1 to 3 feet.

periods.name: Monday night
periods.text: Northwest winds 10 to 15 knots becoming north 15 to 20 knots. Partly cloudy. Waves 1 to 3 feet building to 2 to 4 feet, then subsiding to 1 to 3 feet.

periods.name: Tuesday
periods.text: North winds 15 to 20 knots becoming northeast and diminishing to less than 10 knots in the afternoon. Sunny. Waves 1 to 3 feet subsiding to 1 foot or less.

notes: See Lake Erie open lakes forecast for Wednesday through Friday.
The water temperature off Toledo is 51 degrees, off Cleveland 54 degrees, and off Erie 52 degrees.
